title: Supplemental Poverty Measure rate
cap: Share of people below the Census Bureau's Supplemental Poverty Measure threshold. 2009 and 2025 from P60-290 (Sept 2026); 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2023 as first published (Census 2023 and 2024 releases); the August 2026 threshold correction lowered 2019–2023 by 0.1–0.3 points without changing the trend.
